item.title: Show HN: Spltty – a Markdown-based personal finance CLI built with Claude
item.summary: I built Spltty, a Ruby CLI for tracking shared expenses, custom splits, and settlements using plain Markdown files. The article explains how it evolved from a Claude-managed folder into a CLI Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49187132 Points: 7 # Comments: 2
